# CodeMirror and Lezer

Frondose uses pinned CodeMirror 6 editor, language and Lezer parsing/highlighting
packages. These provide the source editor's native input, selection, undo,
scrolling, search, gutters and syntax parsing. They do not send source files to
any external service. Package versions and integrity hashes are recorded in
`package-lock.json`; package licenses remain in distributed node_modules and
the bundled notice below.
